criteria.description: SecretVersion domain type exists and omits encrypted payload from JSON.
secret_versions and secret_access_audit tables are created additively and existing secrets are migrated to version 1.
Creating or updating a secret writes immutable version rows.
Resolver can return a safe audit manifest alongside resolved plaintext values.
Resolve and runtime apply attempts write audit rows without plaintext.
No plaintext is stored in database schema, logs, read models, or status/result payload additions.
